=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md:deleted (was mode 120000 symlink to ../CLAUDE.md) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR deletes the workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md symlink.
  WHY: Consumer CLAUDE.md sync in update_workflows.yml fails because the upstream file is absent. CI tests test_claude_template_live_parity.py, test_claude_md_section_numbers.py, and test_pr_merge_status_guard.py fail. The seed-repo command cannot dereference the file.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Closed PRs #6209 (Phase 5d) and #6615 (fallback alerts) contain reviewed commits. Fetch with git fetch origin refs/pull/6209/head refs/pull/6615/head, port only the hunks this item needs onto current main, and list every reused commit SHA in the PR description." Expected change site: PR description. Evidence of absence: The PR description contains "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6681\nRefs #6664" with no reused commit SHA list. The editor cannot write the PR description. Severity=low, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Report the consumer ai-issue-pr-status.yml id-token: write limitation in the PR description without changing that wrapper." Expected change site: PR description. Evidence of absence: The PR description does not mention that consumer PR-mode activation verification stays on codex until the consumer's ai-issue-pr-status.yml grants id-token: write. The README and changelog fragment document this, but the PR description does not. The editor cannot write the PR description. Severity=low, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Workflows: workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml, check_failure_triage.yml, issue_pr_status.yml (the activation-verify job) and unblock_judge.yml install the pinned CLI and fetch the pool only when the role resolves to Claude." Expected change site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml (add "Resolve AI engine" step and gate existing "Install Claude Code CLI" and "Resolve Claude credential" steps on its output). Evidence of absence: No hunks for unblock_judge.yml in the PR diff. The issue also says "Only confirm that the Claude path and the exit-75 fallback to isolated Codex are unchanged after the default flips" for unblock_judge, which qualifies as a soft deferral. The existing steps are continue-on-error, so the runtime cost of an unconditional install when codex is chosen is an unused CLI install. Severity=low, confidence=3.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml:Entire jobs definition (unconditional infrastructure steps) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The workflow lacks the required "Install Claude Code CLI" and "Resolve Claude credential" steps that were implemented in other workflows (e.g., check_failure_triage.yml) to support the move to the Claude engine.
  WHY: The UNBLOCK_JUDGE role is designated to default to the Claude engine, but the workflow does not provide the infrastructure steps (or gated infrastructure steps) to support it. As a result, the unblock judge either runs on codex or fails to execute effectively as a Claude-backed agent.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "List every reused commit SHA in the PR description." Expected change site: PR description. Evidence of absence: The supplied PR description contains only the automated-implementation text and issue references; it lists no reused commit SHAs. Severity=low, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Report the consumer activation-verify wrapper’s id-token: write limitation in the PR description without changing that wrapper." Expected change site: PR description. Evidence of absence: The supplied PR description does not mention that consumer activation verification cannot fetch the Claude pool due to the `id-token: write` limitation. Severity=low, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md" symlink (→ ../CLAUDE.md) must exist on the branch. Expected change site: workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md. Evidence of absence: The original PR diff deletes the `workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md` symlink. The file does not exist on the current branch, which disrupts the consumer CLAUDE.md synchronization and causes failures in contract tests (`tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py` and `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py`). Severity=critical, confidence=5.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md symlink (→ ../CLAUDE.md) must exist on the branch. Expected change site: workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md (must be a symlink to ../CLAUDE.md). Evidence of absence: The original PR diff deletes the file as a `deleted file mode 120000` entry (symlink to ../CLAUDE.md). LAST RUN DIFF does not touch workflow-templates/CLAUDE.md. Confirmed downstream failures: tests/test_claude_template_live_parity.py, tests/test_claude_md_section_numbers.py, tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, tests/test_promote_main_cycle.py (explicit path check at line 221), tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py (first-error headline at lines 3659, 3667, 3696), .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml consumer CLAUDE.md sync, and .claude/commands/seed-repo.md and workflow-templates/.claude/commands/seed-repo.md cp -L dereferences it during consumer seeding. The editor's sandbox-excluded-path reasoning is correct, but the file remains absent from the branch and CI will fail on the next full check suite. Severity=critical, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: unblock_judge.yml must install the pinned CLI and fetch the Claude pool only when the role resolves to Claude (the issue explicitly names the four workflows). Expected change site: .github/workflows/unblock_judge.yml (add "Resolve AI engine" step and gate "Install Claude Code CLI" / "Resolve Claude credential" on its output, mirroring the pattern in workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml, check_failure_triage.yml, and issue_pr_status.yml's activation-verify job). Evidence of absence: Original PR diff contains no hunks for unblock_judge.yml. LAST RUN DIFF does not touch unblock_judge.yml. Both steps at lines 128-138 remain unconditional with continue-on-error: true, so they install the CLI and fetch the pool even when AI_ENGINE_UNBLOCK_JUDGE=codex. The editor's reasoning that workflow-level gating cannot see the issue labels is valid, but the AI_ENGINE_UNBLOCK_JUDGE variable is known at workflow level and could gate the no-label default case. Runtime impact is an unused CLI install with continue-on-error, so the failure mode is bounded. Severity=low, confidence=4.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: List every reused commit SHA from #6209 and #6615 in the PR description. Expected change site: PR description (rendered via gh pr create --body). Evidence of absence: The supplied PR description is "Automated implementation. Closes https://github.com/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/issues/6681\nRefs #6664". It contains no reused-commit SHA list. The editor explicitly deferred this in the latest comment ("the editor cannot write the PR description"). The orchestrator poller's PR-body lint (scripts/lint_pr_body_auto_close.py) does not catch a missing SHA list, so this won't fail in CI, but the issue's explicit requirement is unmet. Severity=low, confidence=5.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Report the consumer ai-issue-pr-status.yml id-token: write limitation in the PR description without changing that wrapper. Expected change site: PR description. Evidence of absence: workflow-templates/ai-issue-pr-status.yml grants only issues: write (no id-token: write). The supplied PR description does not mention this limitation, although README and the changelog fragment do. The issue explicitly requires the limitation to be called out in the PR description so consumers understand why their PR-mode activation verification stays on codex. Severity=low, confidence=5.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
